description:
Kirby Super Star Ultra is a remake of the Super Nintendo Entertainment System game Kirby Super Star.
The remake retains all game modes found in the original and adds four major new ones.

kssu-v0.1.0.description:
# Initial Release!

## Features included:
- All 11 Main-Games supported.
- All 5 Sub-Games as a toggleable option.
- Progression barriers for Dyna Blade, TGCO and Meta Knightmare Ultra
- Many different goal options
- Custom commands in the client
- Universal Tracker support
- Deathlink
- And more!
kssu-v0.1.0.title: Kirby Super Star Ultra v0.1.0

kssu-v0.1.1.description:
## Bug fixes
- Updated the location names to match the treasures in TGCO
- Fixed Deathlink
kssu-v0.1.1.title: Kirby Super Star Ultra v0.1.1

kssu-v0.1.2.description:
## Additions
- Added new checks for completing each main-game, which now includes Gourmet Race, The Great Cave Offensive, Milky Way Wishes, Helper to Hero and The True Arena

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed Milky Way Wishes de-spawning uncollected ability if received by the multiworld
- Dyna Blade now no longer incorrectly sends check for uncompleted stages
- The Big Switches in Dyna Blade no longer disappear if the stage was unlocked beforehand
- Subgames were fixed to only send one check after the game is completed and switching difficulties

**This version is NOT backwards compatible with worlds generated with v0.1.0 or v0.1.1!**
The currently known bugs list has been updated in FAQ, be sure to check that first!
kssu-v0.1.2.title: Kirby Super Star Ultra v0.1.2

kssu-v0.1.31.description:
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed incorrect number of Progressive Stages being loaded in Dyna Blade, TGCO and Meta Knightmare Ultra
- Fixed starting planet not saving upon reload
- Fixed client crashing after Iron Mam's defeat
- I don't like Iron Mam

## Known Bugs
- Dyna blade is currently non-functional at the moment. Please exclude this one from your seeds for now.
- For other known bugs, refer to the [FAQ](https://github.com/GhostCappy/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/kssu/docs/FAQ.md).
kssu-v0.1.31.title: Kirby Super Star Ultra v0.1.31

kssu-v0.1.4.description:
## Bug fixes
- Fixed Dyna Blade, which now correctly sends which stages were cleared
- Fixed MWW Completion check to correctly require all 7 planets or 7 rainbow stars if the option is enabled

This version is **NOT** backwards compatible with seeds generated before v0.1.4.
kssu-v0.1.4.title: Kirby Super Star Ultra v0.1.4

kssu-v0.1.41.description:
## Bug fixes
- Fixed "Food" and "Maxim Tomato" items exceeding max HP.
- Fixed an issue where the `The Arena - 19 Straight Wins` wouldn't be sent.
- Meta Knightmare Ultra's `Level 3` and `Iron Mam (Level 2)` locations now are checked at the correct time.

This version is backwards compatible with seeds generated in v0.1.4.

## Known Bugs
Please refer to the [FAQ](https://github.com/GhostCappy/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/kssu/docs/FAQ.md) for all currently known bugs. If you have any questions, feel free to ping!
